stories.title: Over 220 Ukrainian drones taken down over Russian regions during day
stories.summary: On-duty air defense systems intercepted the Ukrainian UAVs over nine Russian regions
article_sentences: More than 220 Ukrainian drones were shot down over Russian regions, the Black and Azov Seas during the day, the Russian defense ministry said.

"From 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Moscow time (5:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. GMT), Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 221 Ukrainian fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles over Crimea, the Belgorod, Bryansk, Kaluga, Kursk, Oryol, Tula, Moscow, and Krasnodar Regions, and over the Azov and Black Seas," it said.

stories.title: Spain investigates possible shotgun marks found on Gibraltar’s oldest orca
stories.summary: The oldest orca in the Strait of Gibraltar and Gulf of Cadiz population appeared in the strait this week
article_sentences: Spanish authorities are probing the discovery of an orca in the Strait of Gibraltar with possible shotgun wounds, the Ministry for Ecological Transition said in a press release.
According to the ministry, the oldest orca in the Strait of Gibraltar and Gulf of Cadiz population appeared in the strait this week.
The ministry said the local orca population is listed as "vulnerable" in Spain’s catalog of endangered species.
This means any action against the species carries serious penalties.
The ministry has launched an investigation into the incident.
